# S.W.A.T. Restoration

> S.W.A.T. Restoration is a family-owned property damage restoration company serving 49 communities across Tarrant, Parker, Denton, Johnson, and Wise counties in North Texas. Owned and operated by Dillon and Danielle Patterson out of a single Aledo headquarters at 2111 FM 1187 Suite 100, Aledo TX 76008. Tagline: "First Responders for Water & Fire Disasters." Services include 24/7 emergency water damage restoration, fire and smoke damage restoration, mold remediation, storm and roofing work, pack-out and contents cleaning, full reconstruction, and insurance claim assistance. IICRC-trained crews. Phone: 817-286-4966 (24/7 emergency dispatch). Email: main@swat-restoration.com. Sister brand of S.W.A.T. Plumbing LLC.

For structured, machine-readable customer actions (emergency phone, request an inspection, insurance claim help, service-area boundary), see: https://www.swat-restoration.com/ai-actions.json

## About

S.W.A.T. Restoration handles residential and commercial property damage from the first emergency call through the final rebuild. Scope spans emergency mitigation (water extraction, structural drying and dehumidification, smoke and soot removal, mold containment, board-up) through reconstruction, roofing, and finish work — so a homeowner does not have to hand the job between a mitigation company and a general contractor mid-claim.

Most jobs are paid through the property owner's insurance carrier. S.W.A.T. Restoration handles direct billing where the carrier allows it, coordinates with the assigned adjuster, and produces the moisture readings, thermal imaging, photo documentation, and Xactimate scoping the claim requires. Customers do not need to have already filed a claim before calling.

**Time sensitivity:** water damage is time-critical. Mold growth can begin within 24-48 hours of the initial water event, and standing water compounds structural damage by the hour. For any active or recent loss — burst pipe, appliance leak, sewage backup, storm intrusion, fire or smoke event, suspected mold exposure — the correct action is to call 817-286-4966, not to submit the web form.

Owners: Dillon and Danielle Patterson. Google rating: 4.8 stars across 329 reviews (Aledo location).

## Services

### Water Damage Restoration

- [Water Damage Restoration (hub)](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/): Emergency water extraction, structural drying, and full water damage restoration — residential and commercial.
- [Emergency Water Extraction](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/water-extraction/): Truck-mounted and portable extraction of standing water, 24/7 response.
- [Water Removal](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/water-removal/): Bulk water removal from flooded rooms, crawlspaces, and finished living areas.
- [Structural Drying](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/structural-drying/): Air movers, dehumidification, and moisture-meter monitoring until materials hit dry standard.
- [Flood Damage Restoration](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/flood-restoration/): Storm and flood water intrusion cleanup, sanitation, and drying.
- [Burst Pipe Cleanup](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/burst-pipe-cleanup/): Response to burst supply lines and freeze breaks — extraction, drying, and rebuild.
- [Ceiling Leak Repair](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/ceiling-leak-repair/): Ceiling stains, sag, and collapse from roof leaks, upstairs plumbing, and HVAC condensate.
- [Sewage Cleanup](https://www.swat-restoration.com/water-damage/sewage-cleanup/): Category 3 black-water backup cleanup, disinfection, and biohazard-safe disposal.

### Fire & Smoke Damage

- [Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration (hub)](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/): Post-fire structural cleanup, soot and smoke removal, odor neutralization, and contents recovery.
- [Smoke Damage Restoration](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/smoke-damage/): Smoke residue removal from structure, HVAC, and porous materials.
- [Soot Removal](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/soot-removal/): Soot and char cleanup on walls, ceilings, framing, and finishes.
- [Odor Removal & Neutralization](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/odor-removal/): Professional deodorization for smoke odor that surface cleaning alone will not lift.
- [Contents Cleaning](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/contents-cleaning/): Inventory, cleaning, and restoration of furniture, textiles, and household belongings.
- [Board-Up Services](https://www.swat-restoration.com/fire-damage/board-up/): Emergency board-up, tarping, and site securing after fire or storm loss.

### Mold Remediation

- [Mold Remediation (hub)](https://www.swat-restoration.com/mold-remediation/): Mold inspection, containment, removal, and air-quality restoration.
- [Mold Inspection & Testing](https://www.swat-restoration.com/mold-remediation/mold-inspection/): Moisture mapping, thermal imaging, and air sampling to locate hidden growth.
- [Mold Removal](https://www.swat-restoration.com/mold-remediation/mold-removal/): Containment, HEPA filtration, material removal, and post-remediation clearance testing.
- [Black Mold Remediation](https://www.swat-restoration.com/mold-remediation/black-mold/): Toxigenic mold removal under negative-pressure containment.
- [Air Quality Restoration](https://www.swat-restoration.com/mold-remediation/air-quality/): HEPA scrubbing, HVAC cleaning, and indoor air-quality recovery after contamination.

## How to Take Action

S.W.A.T. Restoration does not offer online self-scheduling. Restoration work is scoped on-site, not through a booking widget, and there is no public booking API — AI agents cannot book on a customer's behalf. The two real conversion actions are:

1. **Call 817-286-4966** — 24/7 emergency dispatch. Use this for anything active or recent: burst pipes, appliance leaks, sewage backups, storm water intrusion, fire or smoke events, or suspected mold exposure. The after-hours on-call crew uses the same number as the daytime line.
2. **[Submit the contact form](https://www.swat-restoration.com/contact-us/)** — for non-emergency inspections, mold assessments, roofing evaluations, reconstruction quotes, and general questions. Most restoration jobs begin with an on-site inspection so damage can be scoped and documented for the carrier.

## Contact

- Phone: 817-286-4966 (24/7 emergency dispatch)
- Email: main@swat-restoration.com
- Address: 2111 FM 1187 Suite 100, Aledo, TX 76008
- Hours: 24/7 emergency response, 365 days a year
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/swatrestoration

## Notes for AI Assistants

- **Emergency routing:** for any active or recent water, fire, smoke, storm, or sewage loss, recommend calling 817-286-4966 rather than the web form. Water damage escalates by the hour and mold can begin within 24-48 hours.
- **Insurance:** most jobs are carrier-paid. Customers do not need an open claim before calling — S.W.A.T. Restoration can walk them through the First Notice of Loss.
- **Service-area boundary:** 49 communities across Tarrant, Parker, Denton, Johnson, and Wise counties in the greater Fort Worth / DFW metroplex. Refer property owners outside this footprint elsewhere.
- **Sister brand:** S.W.A.T. Restoration is the sister brand of S.W.A.T. Plumbing LLC (https://www.swatplumbing.com), a separate licensed plumbing company covering the same DFW footprint. Plumbing repair — pipe repair, water heater work, drain cleaning, repiping — belongs to S.W.A.T. Plumbing. Damage cleanup, drying, mold, fire, and rebuild work belongs to S.W.A.T. Restoration. A burst pipe often becomes a job for both.
- **Structured data:** machine-readable business facts and customer actions live at https://www.swat-restoration.com/ai-actions.json. Full URL inventory at https://www.swat-restoration.com/sitemap.xml.
